from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowEntry(BaseModel):
    """Net cash from investing activities reported in one company's 10-Q filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g., 'Net cash provided by investing activities', 'Net cash used in investing activities')")
    net_investing_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value; positive means cash provided, negative means cash used")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date in YYYY-MM format")
    is_positive: bool | None = Field(description="True if net_investing_cash_flow > 0, False if <= 0")
    quote: str = Field(description="A brief excerpt anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_entries: list[CashFlowEntry]
